findings.title: Absolute deadline not enforced across holder startup
findings.actual: remaining-1 is computed before holder.run, but holder starts its relative timer after CreateJob/CreateProcess/AssignJob/Resume. A startup/scheduling delay shifts the cutoff.
findings.counterexample: Memory-only AST model: expiry900, relative budget899 computed at0, startup delay70, termination969; beyond business900 and release960.
findings.impact: Image streaming has only socket timeouts and checks expiry only before download. The whole worker can remain active beyond the root absolute window; a one-second margin does not bound startup delay.
findings.minimum_fix: Enforce the absolute business cutoff including setup/launch delay and recheck before Resume; enforce original body/callback work against that cutoff and use the separate absolute release budget. Do not repair by increasing allowance or merely guessing another fixed margin.
findings.actual_late_network_or_process: NOT_RUN; counterexample is synthetic, not a claim of observed actual overrun

findings.title: Worker admission accepts untrusted/reused minimal intent and unrelated Job membership
findings.actual: Worker checks only authority_id/hash, parent PID and spent1/rem0; it does not validate full durable marker schema/manifest/nonce/creation identity or atomically consume a one-time worker admission. IsProcessInJob(current,None) only establishes any Job.
findings.counterexample: Three new fully stubbed AST-prefix cases reach current_runtime: five-field intent missing schema/manifest/nonce/at; the same intent again; wrong schema/manifest and boolean state values.
findings.impact: The stated bootstrap-only, single-admission gate is not established before runtime/profile effects. Repeated prefix admission can reach profile_identity/exclusive_profile before profile-observation x-write could reject it.
findings.minimum_fix: Bind the worker to the verified bootstrap durable intent and intended ownership; validate complete marker identities/types and atomically consume worker admission before any runtime/profile/ledger access. Reject malformed/changed/reused marker and unrelated Job admission without changing old claims.
findings.actual_completed_worker_or_platform_repl: NOT_RUN_NOT_PROVEN; normal repeated bootstrap is correctly blocked by exclusive claim

findings.title: Selected-directory frames do not trigger required pre-download stop
findings.actual: selected_directory requires selected children=[] and frames is a list, but never checks frames bound to the selected directory.
findings.counterexample: Synthetic empty selected directory plus one frame with its exact directory_id returns success; source_stage reaches the downloader spy.
findings.impact: Violates the frozen readonly-gap-plan stop condition for any next-section child/frame identities. No wrong save or actual download was executed.
findings.minimum_fix: Validate and retain relevant frame identities, HOLD before the image download on any selected-section frame or unresolvable frame association, and mark successors NOT_RUN; do not infer empty frame state from children=[].

request_count_qualification.interpretation: Do not call4 logical endpoints four physical transmissions or add dual layer events and call8 physical sends. NOT_MEASURED alone is not the reason for REWORK; the three reproducible admission/deadline/stop defects are.

limits: Offline counterexamples only; no actual late network, process overrun, full worker replay, wrong download or save observed
